releaseNotes: THE SWITCHER FIX — Discord clones no longer crash and the account switcher actually appears now. If you cloned Discord on v2.0.0 and the clone crashed (or holding your profile tab did nothing), update the cloner and CLONE AGAIN: the new clone is stable and the quick menu opens when you hold your own profile tab.

WHAT WAS BROKEN: the switcher module injected into Discord clones contained helper classes whose shortened names collided with Discord's own internal class names. Android picked Discord's classes over ours, so the switcher broke the moment it tried to open — crash or dead gesture. Every helper class now lives under a name Discord can never have, and the build refuses to ship if that rule is ever violated again.
The fix is proven against the exact current Discord stable build (34712) — patched, installed-structure verified, zero name collisions with Discord's 17,800+ classes (and Roblox's 26,500+).
Same signing key as v2.0.0 — this installs as a normal update over your existing cloner, keeping all your clone registry and settings.
Everything else is untouched: Roblox support with the split-screen/small-screen unlock, the full family app list, and all v1.9.0 features work exactly as before.
